SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as num_trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0)::float, 3) as yt_per_angler,
  ROUND(AVG(yt)::numeric, 2) as avg_yt_per_trip
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy BETWEEN 91 AND 120 AND fish_date_season = 2
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls
LIMIT 100;

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy, 
  cls, 
  COUNT(*) as trips, 
  SUM(yt) as total_yt, 
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) * 1.0 / SUM(anglers), 3) as yt_per_angler,
  ROUND(AVG(yt), 2) as avg_yt_per_trip
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 
  AND fish_date_doy >= 91 
  AND fish_date_doy <= 125
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls;

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy, 
  cls, 
  COUNT(*) as trips, 
  SUM(yt) as total_yt, 
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) * 1.0 / SUM(anglers), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 
  AND fish_date_doy >= 125 
  AND fish_date_doy <= 180
  AND cls IN ('overnight', 'day_1_5')
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy;

SELECT DISTINCT 
  fish_date_doy, 
  cls, 
  COUNT(*) as boat_count
FROM schedule
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 
  AND fish_date_doy >= 130 
  AND fish_date_doy <= 160
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls;
